⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Stars — Absolutely Saved My Dog's Life!

Because of their incredible care, skill, and quick action, I still have my precious little girl in my life today. From start to finish, the level of care and communication was unmatched. They kept me updated on everything happening while she was in their care, which gave me so much peace of mind during such a scary situation. When I came to pick her up, the surgeon even took the time to personally sit down and speak with me. Special thanks to Jason, Dr. Chilo, Kim, Gabby, and Cesar—everyone went above and beyond to ensure Bella was taken care of and that I could rest assured she was going to be okay.
If you ever find yourself in need of emergency or preventive care for your pets, I cannot recommend My Pet Hospital enough. Im a dog groomer and will recommend them to anyone who needs pet care. They are compassionate, professional, and truly lifesavers!

Shadow arrived in pain, his steps slow and weary, his kidneys damaged by stones. At Kendall Pointe Animal Hospital, he found light, wise and steely hands, a truly wonderful team that lifted his heavy burden. The scalpel carefully removed the danger, and today Shadow is recovering, joyful and free. Thank you, courageous doctors, for your dedication and unwavering faith; today, life and nobility beat stronger once more. Shadow spent a week and several days under their care after a very serious injury, and from the first moment, we knew he was surrounded by people who truly cared for him. The medical care was exceptional, but what made this experience so special was the compassion, dedication, and affection we received from everyone involved in his recovery. He arrived with slow steps and fear, seeking relief from his pain. In their uniforms, he found faith, and in their warm hands, goodness. They cared for his body with great skill, and seeing the light and heartbeat of my faithful companion return to him, bringing him back to my side. Words cannot express my gratitude for such noble care. They healed his life with dedication, and they now have a place in my heart: Dr. Gallardo (Surgery and Emergencies), Dr. Luis Garcia, Dr. Vasallo, Dr. Del Monte, Dr. Monroe, Dr. Puron, Dr. Aquiles, Yuni Gallardo, Dr. Leonay Carballo, Yamile Monroy, Juan Pablo Garcia, all the nurses, the technicians, all the front desk staff, and in general, the entire team at this wonderful clinic. A thousand thanks! 💞💞💞💞💞🏵🏵🏵🏵

I don’t even know where to start. I found this stray cat in my apartment complex a month ago with a badly injured eye and a wound to the face. It was a Sunday so almost every vet or shelter/rescue I called didn’t answer or were closed. By pure luck and the grace of God, I found My Pet Hopsital on Google and they were open and told me to bring her in and they would see what they could do for her. They took her into a room without hesitation and gave her pain medication and antibiotics, which is really all they could do at that moment. The doctor (Dr. Shake) said the eye would need to be removed eventually. I was able to raise funds for the stray to get the care she needed. Dr. Shake was meticulous and careful every step of the way. He didn’t rush her into surgery, he made sure she was healthy enough to undergo anesthesia. We found out she had hookworm which was likely causing her anemia. Her white blood cells were high as well which was her body trying to fight whatever it was she had. After a long process, she was ready for surgery and the eye was removed. Sadly, after surgery, I found lumps on her belly, which tests confirmed was cancer. This last week was a quick decline and after careful deliberation with the doctor and vet techs, we all agreed euthanasia was the most humane option for her. It was likely the cancer started somewhere in the eye/mouth/nasal area and spread to her belly and other parts of her body. She was suffering. I would recommend this hospital to anybody and everybody. The location on 124th is small but mighty . The entire staff care so much.  My situation was very unique, because it was a stray, but throughout the process they were all rooting for her and believed in her as much as I did . They didn’t turn me away, or jump to euthanizing Sunday. Instead, they were patient, caring and truly wanted to help her and give her the happy ending we all hoped for. I have nothing but gratitude for every single staff member there. To the front desk, the vet techs, the doctors and the owner, you can see they all truly love animals and treat them like their own. I feel so lucky to have found them that Sunday. I can’t thank them enough for everything they did to try and give Sunday the best outcome at a quality life. I know she felt love from all of us in her final days. Thank you My Pet Hospital for your care, compassion, empathy , patience, warmth with not only Sunday but with me as well. Sunday and I are forever grateful for your kindness and support. To Dr. Shake and Monica, a very special thank you to both of you for going above and beyond for my Sunday girl.

This place took advantage of a vulnerable situation and it shows.

My father brought our dog in after already having bloodwork and X-rays done at Banfield. Instead of reviewing what was already completed and being mindful of cost, they repeated multiple tests—charging for additional X-rays and bloodwork that were unnecessary at that point.

What’s worse is that after all of that, they still did NOT perform the one thing that actually would have given us a definitive answer—a biopsy. So we left with a huge bill, no clear diagnosis, and more confusion than when we walked in.

When families come in, they are scared and trying to do the right thing for their pet. That is not the time to run every possible test without clear communication, direction, or cost-conscious decision-making.

The lack of transparency and the way my father was treated made it feel like profit came before patient care.

If you go here, be very careful. Ask questions, set limits, and do not assume they will guide you with your best interest in mind.

We went yesterday with our dachshund to put her to sleep as she was very old and very sick and we knew it was about time, we didn’t want her to suffer any longer, and it was visible she was done, she was a 18 years old dog with a heart murmur. When we got there they told us the doctor had to see our dog and that was an extra fee over what we already had to pay to euthanize her, for us it didn’t make any sense as you could see the dog was old and sick and we just didn’t want her to be in pain, not only they charged us more but the doctor never saw her, only an assistant came out and asked us a couple of questions, that was it, that was the “consultation” and that was $95 more, for almost a $500 all you get is to put your dog to sleep because you can’t even have her ashes as that’s a different price, and that’s not the worst, the worst part is that they didn’t even let me see her and be with her in her final moments, she had to die alone and afraid, in pain with a whole bunch of estranged which I’m sure didn’t give her the slightest sign of compassion, just because they said I couldn’t be there as an owner, WHAT?! This is cruel, the say they care about pets, please!!!! No, they only care about what little thing they can do to your dog to charge more, they only care about the money, not the dog or the owners feelings or best interests, this was so sad and disappointing. I honestly didn’t run anywhere else because it was Sunday, it was pouring outside, I was exhausted and it was just too much for my doggy, but this place I do not recommend. Shame on them! The worst experience of my life with a vet. They have no compassion, no sympathy, nothing! Your dog is supposed to be with you when he/she is about to die, not alone, you’re the last thing they’re supposed to see, not a stranger! Absolutely heartless!

I took my dog to this veterinary clinic during a critical situation. The veterinarian did not perform any tests, blood work, or imaging, and immediately insisted my dog had pyometra and needed emergency surgery. They quoted us nearly $3,000, including almost $900 for tests that they wanted to run, based solely on their personal assumption.

The very next day, I took my dog to another veterinarian. They performed proper diagnostics and explained that the problem was actually a kidney issue, not pyometra. The total cost there was around $400 for everything, including medications and tests.

I am deeply concerned that a clinic would recommend such an expensive, invasive surgery without confirming the diagnosis, and try to charge nearly $900 for unnecessary tests. This is reckless and shows a serious lack of basic veterinary ethics.

Pet owners trust veterinarians to act responsibly and base decisions on evidence, not assumptions. My experience was extremely disappointing, and I strongly advise caution before taking your pet to this clinic
